(shrī)༄༅/ /grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs yig cha ye shes bcud sbyin gyi lhan thabs mthong bas don rtogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs yig cha ye shes bcud sbyin gyi lhan thabs mthong bas don rtogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na maḥshrī māṃ gu ra we/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen lang tshos sgeg /rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya chen mos 'khyud// tshe lus gcig gis zung 'jug rgyal sar gshegs// grub pa'i tshogs dang dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs// spyi bor mchod nas grub brnyes brgyad cu bzhi'i// byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bskur nod pa la// nyer mkho'i zur 'degs rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bka'// rjes su bsgrub slad nyung ngu rnam gsal spel// de la 'di ni rdo rje'i ye shes 'pho ba'i dbang bskur yin pas gnang ba po'i bla ma'ang bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i rang zhal nang du mjal bas slob ma'i rgyud la rtogs pa don gyi ye shes 'pho nus pa zhig dgos par mngon zhing*/ slob ma'ang mos gus dang ting nge 'dzin 'brel bas thugs rgyud kyi ye shes thim phod dang sim phod du gyur pa'i skal can nam/ tha na'ang dmigs rnam la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni nges par gal che ba las rdzas sngags kyi rnam grangs spros bcas gzhan ltar bskur thob mang po can yang ma yin pas zhus lo tsam gyis thob par dka' ba dang*/ dus kyang yar mar gyi tshes bcu lta bu phyi nang gi 'du ba mthun pa'i tshe sogs dpon slob gnas dus kyi rten 'brel tshogs pa na/ gang du bya ba'i gnas khang byi dor dang rten bkram pa'i gung du stegs bu khebs ldan nar mo'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdzes tshon/ de rgyab gru bzhir bskor ba'i gru chad phyogs mdog byas pa'i dbus su 'bru'i tshom bu'i khar bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku bris 'bur gang rung bzhugs/ de'i mdun du bum pa mgul chings sngon po dri dang nyer lnga'i rdzas ldan dung chos gzungs rdor bcas/ g.yas su gsang dbang gi chas thod par chang la chos sman dang mngar gsum btab pa/

rgyab tu rig tsaka g.yon sogs gar bder las bum mgul chings ljang gu can bcud ldan/ mdun ngos nang mchod thod pa/ 'bul gtor zlum po rgyan ldan/ chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar/ sngon gtor/ nyin re bzhin tshogs mchod lcogs na tshogs kyi yo byad kyang bsham mo// thog mar sgo 'byed byin rlabs kyi tshul du bla ma'i dbang bzhi bsgrubs shing bskur/ de mtshams grub chen gsum lnga bdun sogs gang lcogs bskur sgrub stabs gcig tu byed pa yin pas/ rjes ma rnams la maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gyis bri ba sogs ma lcogs tshe tshom bu bkod pa kho nas 'thus/ bum thod rig tsaka rnams kyang thog ma'i de las mi mkho bas bkod mi dgos/ byin rlabs ji tsam byed pa'i grangs bstun gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu can pho brang du bkram pa'i dbus so so'i bris sku bzhugs/ de'ang g.yas nas mgo brtsams gral rim bya/ nang mchod spyi la gcig dang*/ phyi mchod re re la tshar re bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo dril/ ḍa ma ru/ nas ze/ nang mchod bcas 'du bya/ cho ga dngos la 'jam mgon grol mchog zhabs kyi bzhed par/ slob dpon skad cig gis bde dgyes lta bu bla med kyi lha gang rung gsal bas nang mchod dang gnas yo byin rlabs tsam byas nas bdag mdun sgrub pa dang bdag nyid 'jug pa sogs mi mdzad par/ khrus nas bzung slob ma rjes gzung thar chags su btang zin rjes tshogs 'khor sogs kyis mthar dbyung*/ las bum sgrub pa'ang 'di rigs la dmigs bsal mi mdzad cing*/ spyir jo nang phyag srol la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ lta bu las sngags tsam brjod pas khrus chab byin rlabs dang bkye ba mnyam du mdzad/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trām̐ zhes pas me tog bkye ba tsam las ji ltar bltams pa'i tshigs bcad sogs phal cher brjod srol mi 'dug go /de dag ni 'phags yul ba'i phyag bzhes zang ma byin rlabs 'bogs pa'i cho ga la de tsam las mi dgos pa khungs dang 'brel yang*/

ye shes mchog brnyes pa'i skyes chen 'ga' zhig gi spyod yul las/ da lta ni ye shes 'pho bar nus pa'i dpon slob rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i shin tu dkon pas byin rlabs 'di nyid kyi rgyun ma chad tsam pa'i 'chad spel byed tshe/ cho ga'i spros pa'ang cung zad rgyas pa'i cha lag tshang bar mdzad pa sngon gyi lugs rnying spyi dang*/ bka' brgyud 'di'i bla ma rnams kyi phyag srol la'ang 'byung bas/ de ltar na bde mchog yab yum lta bu'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas bgyid dgos pa las/ phag mo la mtshon na/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo sogs bdag lhar gsal ba/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ sngon gtor nas/ bzlas pa bsdu ldang yan bdag gi rnal 'byor tshang bar bya/ de nas jo nang phyag bzhes sor bzhag byed na/ gsham gsal las bum bsgrub pa tsam spro na 'dir byas te/ 'brug chen kun gzigs chos kyi snang bas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs yig cha ye shes bcud sbyin ltar/ khrus dang maṇ+ḍal nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du rdo rje 'chang gi byin rlabs slob ma la ji ltar 'bogs pa de nyid tshig gi mtshams sbyor phran bu kha bsgyur nas rang gis tshar gcig blang*/ de nas slob ma rjes su gzung ste gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ 'on kyang rdo rje 'chang la mtshan ma rdzas kyi dbang bzhi bskur du yod pas de'i dmigs rnam dod pa'i phyir du gong smos ltar yig rnying lugs su mdun bum sgrub par byed na bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas grub mtshams/ mdun bskyed rten/ oṃ āḥbi gh+nān gyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma gang du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i zhing khams rgya khyon tshad med pa/ ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa 'byams su klas shing rang snang mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs pa'i dbus su/ seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po/

sku mdog in+d+ra nī la'i phung po ltar sngo zhing 'od zer 'bar ba/ shin tu zhi zhing mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin cing rang snang shes rab mchog gi bde bar spyod pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ dran pa tsam gyis bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyed par nus pa'i bdag nyid rtsa gsum kun gyi spyi gzugs su gsal ba la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hoḥser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtshos bskor ba spyan drang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drang*/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs dus kyi dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus te sngags phreng la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi rol par gyur/

oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra hūm̐/ zhes bzla/ de nas mchod bstod ni/ rgyas par spro na mchod pa byin brlabs te/ rgyal ba'i sku la sogs dang*/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs/ nang gsang gnyis sngags mchod mthar/ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// sogs bstod pa'ang rgyas pa bya/ bsdu na/ rang las mchod pa'i lha mo ni// mchod rdzas sna tshogs rab 'dzin pa// nam mkha' gang bar spros byas nas// mdun bskyed lha tshogs ma lus mchod// oṃ shrī mān ma hā gu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin sbyar te/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ bcas sbyar/ badz+ra pañtsa a mṛ ta ā hūm̐/ badz+ra ma taṃ gi āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ 'bul gtor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun 'bul/ bdag dang slob ma rnams la mchog dang thun mongs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rnam rgyal bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las phyi rin po che'i bum pa la/ nang gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin/ bcud pam̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ sogs nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar gong mdun bskyed skabs ltar brjod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng gi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril nas song ba bum lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/

sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces bzlas pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyi mthar mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ mthar dung chu phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bum lha bdud rtsir zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur/ las bum bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rin po che'i bum pa'i dbus su pad nyi la hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon/ g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub can/ khro bo'i chas thams cad dang ldan pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyis bzhengs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drang*/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yon grub pas dbu brgyan/ thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las khro bo'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa dang*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig tsam bzla/ khro bo'i dbang pos bgegs thams cad bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces las bcol/ de nas bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ khrus dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid/ ces pa nas/ byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod bar dbang chog ye shes bcud sbyin ltar/ khyed rang zhes pa'i mal du rang nyid sogs kha bsgyur thar chags su btang grub mtshams/ dam tshig khas len/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal sogs rjes spyi mthun byas la/ slob ma rjes su gzung ba'ang*/ khrus dang me tog bkye bsdu/ dbang bshad nas brtsams/ rjes kyi bya ba yan tshang bar bya/ mdun bskyed slob ma la bstims zin pas rjes chog mi dgos so// de nas lū hi pa nas brtsams thengs rer grub chen du tsam gyi byin rlabs byed pa de'i grangs kyi maṇ+ḍal mchod pa bsham/

bdag mdun bum sgrub sogs gong gi rigs 'gre mi dgos pas slob ma la bskur ba ltar slob dpon rang nyid kyis byin rlabs tshar re blangs zin nas/ khrus dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i byin rlabs rnams mthar chags su btang bas 'grub bo// de'i tshe zhag gis bar chod pa'i mtshams rnams su dgongs mor 'byor na tshogs 'khor re dang*/ nangs mo bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas tshar gcig btang la de mtshams khar sang 'phros kyi grub chen gang yin gyi byin rlabs len pa la 'jug go /de lta bu'i tshul gyis byā li pa'i bar brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs grub nas/ yi dam mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi gdan dmar po la tshom bu sngon po 'god/ ma grub na 'bru tshom spyi ltar/ phyag mtshan ral gri zhags pa'i tsakli/ mdun du dkar gtor pad 'dab can che ba gcig g.yas g.yon phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la de las chung gnyis dang mchod pa rnam bdun bsham/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i snod bzang po rnams su hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā sogs/ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da bar/ badz+ra ghāṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs kyis mchod pa byin brlab/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs dang*/ sems can thams cad sogs kyis skyabs sems tshad med bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du mos/ stong pa'i ngang las lus 'od kyi phung po/ rang gi snying ga'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po 'od 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ lus gang zhing sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ phyir 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las rang nyid gtum po chen po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/

g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa sdigs mdzub la lan gnyis su dkris shing thugs kar gtod pa/ zhabs g.yon gyi pus mo dang g.yas kyi mthil sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhengs stabs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyi g.yas pa steng du gzigs pas lha'i bu'i bdud tshar gcod cing*/ g.yas pa 'og tu gzigs pas lha min dang klu'i gdon 'dul ba dang*/ dbus thad kar gzigs pas sa steng gi bgegs thams cad 'joms pa/ cher 'khrugs shing khros pas khro gnyer bsdus shing*/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pas mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po thor tshugs su bcings shing zur phud lnga dang ldan pa sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i sham thabs dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sbrul dkar po'i se ral kha byas pa/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// rang gi thugs kar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ nas 'bru tsam/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa sngar gyi rigs bdag dang dbyer med du gyur/ ting 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba de'i 'od kyis bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pas bdag la thim/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal gyi sa gzhir 'od kyi phung po/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po 'od 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/

slar 'dus pa las gtum po chen po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sogs nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar tshang bar bya/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod/ de'i nang du āḥlas lha'i bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ snying po'i mthar/ ār+ya a tsa la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+yā'i bar gyis mchod/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang*// sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad// 'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*// srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad pa// srid pa'i chu bo skem shing bdud rnams 'joms// srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje'i mgon// rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang slob ma rnams la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ dkar gtor gcig phyogs skyong bcu la cha gsum ltar 'bul/ gcig shos bsang sbyang*/ cha gsum ltar byin brlab/ sam+bha ra lan gsum dang*/ gshegs bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ sa'i lha mo brtan mas gtsor byas mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam gling spyi dang*/ khyad par bod kha ba can/ bye brag sa phyogs yul ris 'di skor gyi gzhi bdag gnas bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas shing glo bur du 'dus pa'i tshogs ma lus pa la 'bul gyi/ 'di bzhes la bdag cag dpon slob sbyin pa'i bdag por bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ bsam sbyor dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa/ 'dod rgu yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs dam pa mdzod cig

ces bsngo/ dril gsil bcas/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs sh+lo kas chos sbyin bya'o// bdag 'jug grub na'ang legs la ma byas kyang 'gal ba med/ slob ma 'tshogs/ khrus dang me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed zab mo gsan dgongs pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir skabs su bab pa gtum chen khro bo'i dbang po mi g.yo ba'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa yin te/ de yang sngon ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs shig dge slong zhig mnyam par 'jog cing gnas pa la/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po dga' rab dbang phyug mi nag rta nag gi rnam pa can dgu tshigs lta bu'i lam nas byung ste bar chad brtsams pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs ka nas gtum po khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med par sprul te bdud 'khor dang bcas pa tshar bcad cing zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan pa'i cho 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad do// des na khro bo'i rgyal po 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs las ched du sprul pa yin pas dngos grub myur zhing bdud kyi bar chad bzlog pa la lhag par bsngags/ rgyud sde'ang bzhi ka las gsungs pas/ bla med kyi dbang du byas pa'i mi g.yo bla med lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs bka' gdams lugs/ mi g.yo dkar po/ spre'u brgyad pa sogs zur bka' khyad par can mang du bzhugs pa las/ skabs 'dir yi dam 'bogs pa'i tshul du paṇa chen rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam gyi lha drug gi nang tshan nang gi bar chad sel ba mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugs kyi rjes su gnang ba mdzad pa brgyud pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyi phyag srol las 'byung ba yin zhing*/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung slob dpon dzai tā ri la rnam snang gang chen mtshos thugs rgyud bskul zhing byin brlabs/

lhag pa'i lhas gnang ba stsal nas mdzad de rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po sogs las bdag gi bla ma'i bar rim par brgyud pa yin la/ de'i lugs kyi rjes gnang gi cho ga bgyid pa la bdag nyid kyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub zin pas/ khyed rang slob ma'i bya ba las thog mar rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug slar slob dpon gyis kyang gnang ba zhu ba'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du rgyun bshags dang skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub sems gzung ba la sogs pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ khyad par du khro bo'i dbang po mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang stsal du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la gtum chen khro bo'i dbang po mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ da sbyor ba rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad pa zhu/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ khyod rang gi lus 'od kyi phung por gyur pa'i snying ga'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma sogs nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin gsal gdab/ de nas slob dpon yang rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i khro bo'i dbang po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas khro bo mi g.yo ba'i sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de dag ni rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'o// rjes gnang dngos la/ lung gsum las/ dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung blang ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gyi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi kha nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor phul ba'i mos pa mdzod cig slob dpon gyis me tog 'thor zhing*/

bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la gtum chen khro bo'i dbang po mi g.yo ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig gsum pa dam bca' ba'i lung gi phyir/ khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba 'di nyid ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yi dam du gzung ngo*// bdag thugs kyis ma gtong zhig snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di/ zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ gtum chen khro bo'i dbang po mi g.yo ba yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas 'di'i gsang sngags nyi ma re re bzhin ci nus su 'don par dam bca' lags so// zhes lan gsum/ des dngos gzhi lung gsum song*/ da ni rjes byin gyis brlab phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung dung pa dang bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa mdzad pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka nas phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces phyag mtshan snying gar 'grims/ des khro chen mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang legs par grub pa yin pas de'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ji nus su bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ dge bsngo byas la grol lo// 'di dang khyad par gyi byin rlabs chu srung sbrel dgos pa byung na sgrub thabs rin 'byung las shes par bya'o// rjes chog mchod pa kha gso byin brlab sngar ltar/ oṃ ār+ya a tsa la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe sogs la āḥhūm̐ sbyar bas mchod/ gtor 'bul skabs ltar/ kye kye mtha' gnyis sogs bstod pa nas 'dod don gsol gdab bar/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gtso bor nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs// zhes nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig sogs kyis ye shes pa brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med na/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ rang nyid stong nyid la blo bzhag dge ba bsngo'o// de nas bka' sdod chos skyong gi byin brlabs bsham sogs dbang bsgrigs dkyus nas 'byung ba ji lta ba tshang bar bya/ slar mchod pa kha gso/ tshogs kyi yo byad bzang zhing rgya che ba 'du byas la byin brlabs nas rdo rje'i glu'i bar rje 'brug pa'i ljags bsgrigs las 'byung ba ltar tshang bar grub mtshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod nas brtsams/ bkra shis bsngo smon bcas rtsa ba'i bdag bskyed dang bstun dgos pas skabs 'dir phag mo ltar byas pas legs par 'grub bo// ye shes sku brnyes grub pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs snying la 'bebs pa'i thabs zab mo// mkhas dang grub pa mang pos gsal mdzad mod// nyer mkho'i zur 'degs lhan thabs tshul du spel// so skye'i blo gros skyon gyi rang bzhin phyir// nongs pa bshags so de thob dge ba'i chas// grub pa'i khyu chen gang du gshegs pa'i shul// zung 'jug rgyal sa kun gyis thob par shog /ces pa'ang rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i bka' stsal gtsug tu mchod nas/ gang gi 'bangs tha karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos/ kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i dbang bsgrigs kyi lhan thabs tshul du dpal spungs ri khrod kun bde gling du spel ba dge legs 'phel//

//sarba maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
